units.source_text: 她想起，当她注意到神护寺里那幅平重盛和源赖朝的肖像

en.t: She remembered that when she noticed the portraits of Taira no Shigemori and Minamoto no Yoritomo at Jingoji Temple

units.source_text: （此画还被安德烈·马尔罗誉为世界名画）上，

en.t: which Andre Malraux had also praised as a world masterpiece,

units.source_text: 重盛的脸颊还是什么地方隐约残留着绯红的时候，

en.t: and saw that a faint crimson still lingered on Shigemori's cheek or somewhere about his face,
Masako had said the same thing too.

units.source_text: 而且，千重子从前也听真砂子讲过好几次同样意思的话。

en.t: And Chieko had heard Masako say much the same thing several times before.
